description: This file defines the class 'SearchQueryWhereDelegate' which implements 'SearchQueryWhereStep' for Hibernate Search queries, providing customized 'where' clause handling with delegate pattern and support for additional predicates. It is used internally by 'SearchQuerySelectDelegate' in the OpenMRS search query infrastructure.

classes.description: Implements SearchQueryWhereStep to provide delegated 'where' clause functionality with support for additional predicates, used internally within Hibernate Search query handling.
